purpose: Define the mandatory production-evidence standard for testing, fixing, validating, recovering, and declaring P2GC/MILES systems complete.

finalDeclaration.notes: Explicit CEO approvals that are intentionally required by governance are not manual recovery dependencies.

requiredGates.description: Persistent MILES runtime is online, cycling, truthful, and free of critical runtime errors.
Normal operation and recovery do not depend on CEO shell administration.
Independent watchdog heartbeat is fresh and controlled owner-stop proof demonstrates watchdog-originated recovery.
Governed GitHub directives self-update safely, execute only allowlisted jobs, publish truthful evidence, and are demonstrably consumed after normal control-owner wake/recovery.
Current main is healthy, required files and tests pass, and production has no critical tracked drift or duplicate owner.
Required capabilities are registered, routable, and genuinely executable with no unexplained critical gaps.
Active ORION is readable, schema-complete, provenance-backed, genuinely refreshed, integrity-validated, query-validated, and safely promotable/rollback-capable.
Recommendations, personas, opportunities, recompetes, and partner intelligence derive from current supported sources and fail closed when evidence is absent.

Campaign inventory, sender assignments, lead lifecycle, replies, source campaign mapping, hard-bounce/technical suppression, and CRM progression reconcile to live provider truth; protected pathways2gc.com mailboxes are excluded from outbound campaigns unless explicitly authorized, and provider bounce metrics reconcile to actual DSN evidence.
Lead through send, bounce/suppression where applicable, reply, classification, CRM, and meeting/progression works end-to-end under governance.
Real placement evidence distinguishes Inbox, Spam, Promotions or equivalent; delivery alone is insufficient.
SPF/DKIM/DMARC are observed in received-message evidence for production senders and unresolved anomalies block GREEN.

Mailbox hygiene, folder routing, reply truth, and no-delete governance reconcile to actual mailboxes, and a recurring governed hygiene loop demonstrably prevents routable bounce/system noise from re-accumulating in executive Inbox under normal operation.
Calendly is authoritative for scheduled meetings and MILES pipeline counts reconcile to live Calendly truth.
Actual sends comply with approved windows and governing code prevents unauthorized-window sends.
Prospect/client records, statuses, work, meetings, and material duplicate handling reflect real operational state.
Revenue, pipeline, deals, invoices/subscriptions where used reconcile to genuine records; goals are never presented as actuals.
Health scores and statuses reconcile to underlying work, blockers, failures, approvals, and client deliverables.
Infrastructure audit works and the scheduler itself demonstrates autonomous production execution on the governed cadence.
Dashboard server and APIs load in production; every displayed metric is current, truthful, source-reconciled, and stale/error states are explicit.
Every current dashboard tab/link loads, renders, performs intended interactions, uses real data where claimed, has no dead routes, and displays truthful acceptance labels.
Live company lookup and intelligence use real identifiers/sources; unsupported facts are not invented.
Prime/sub recommendations are reproducible and supported by real matching evidence and current intelligence.
Opportunity records have real source/status/agency/date context and stale or unsupported records are labeled.
Vehicle positions, gaps, and recommendations reconcile to supported contract/vehicle records.
Incumbent, value, date, and recompete claims appear only when evidence supports them; uncertainty fails closed.
Solicitation intake through requirements, compliance, strategy, production, QA, packaging/readiness works and SUBMITTED is impossible without submission proof.
Dashboard command reaches the governed execution backend and returns truthful accepted/executed task evidence.
Actions requiring CEO approval stop at approval; permitted actions continue autonomously.
No unauthorized prospect sends, provider mutation, email deletion, DNS/B12/calendar changes, destructive Git action, or fabricated completion.
Critical missing/error states become RED/WATCH/UNKNOWN with evidence rather than silently reverting to sample/default truth.
After all fixes, required gates are rerun against current main/current production so acceptance is not based on superseded evidence.
Canonical manifest contains every required gate, timestamps, evidence references, zero blockers, and overall ALL_SYSTEMS_GO.
